recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中央有一個大型、邊界清楚的結節，由淡粉紅色細胞質、長橢圓形核的類上皮組織球（epithelioid histiocytes）緊密聚集，外圍有淋巴球環繞，中央無壞死，符合非壞死性肉芽腫（non-necrotizing granuloma）。
features: Large, well-circumscribed granuloma composed of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and elongated, oval to reniform nuclei
Rim of small lymphocytes at the periphery of the granuloma
Possible small multinucleated cell near the lower edge (resolution limited)
Surrounding cellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and fat spaces
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a large, well-circumscribed granuloma composed of tightly clustered epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and elongated vesicular nuclei, rimmed by small lymphocytes. There is no central necrosis. A possible multinucleated cell is present at the lower edge, and the surrounding marrow is cellular with trilineage hematopoiesis. Findings are consistent with a non-necrotizing epithelioid granuloma; in the clinical context of sarcoidosis this is supportive, after exclusion of infection with AFB and fungal stains and cultures.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas frequently have caseous necrosis and AFB-positive bacilli, which must be excluded with stains and culture.
Fungal granulomas can contain yeast forms highlighted by GMS or PAS stains.
Hodgkin involvement shows CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background, often with fibrosis.
Drug-related granulomas are morphologically similar and are separated by medication history rather than histology.
